titulo_ja: ものだ と ものか (3)

ものなら.es: si se pudiera; si fuera posible

texto: It expresses a special quality or impression that arouses a reaction: **この えいが に は、 心 に 残る もの が ある** (this film has something that remains in memory).
No equivale automáticamente a «merece la pena hacer algo»; para eso puede usarse **価値がある**.
To talk about something that would be possible if you could: verb in the form of possibility + **ものなら**: **できる ものなら、 にほん へ いきたい** (if you could, you would want to go to Japan).
It sounds like an impossible or difficult desire.
